Expected source uses the common frozen grammar, so correlated specification error remains a limitation; hand-written disjoint fixtures and direct typing/source review mitigate it.
independence.metric_check: Distinct reachable value expression IDs, iterative expanded-node traversal and binder-depth traversal are computed separately from the producer.
